## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the Just recipes and other checks run, with their results. State any
coverage that was unavailable.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Reusable source and documentation are in English.
- [ ] Examples use only synthetic data.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, private paths or organization-specific policy were added.
- [ ] Contract compatibility and derived manifest changes were reviewed.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass without weakening behavioral expectations.
